entries.claim_boundary: Orbital comparison uses the charged global R_rel action without declaring it gauge. No all-Hodge, observer or quantum promotion follows.

dispersion.statement: The exact homogeneous Hamiltonian has a size-two zero Jordan block and no exponential root.

lee_wald.statement: The unrestricted global pair has canonical two-form dQ_rel wedge dpsi and positive transverse augmented-energy curvature 1/I.

resonance.statement: The secular linear solution is exactly the Q_rel derivative of the physical relative-equilibrium family, not a gauge direction.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: Lifted boundedness and absolute compact-clock Lyapunov stability fail by physical dephasing.

causal_retarded.statement: The imported unary causal carrier does not turn this finite-dimensional stability result into nonlinear causal response.

smooth_secular.statement: Phi_t(psi,Q)=(psi+t Q/I,Q) and d_Q Phi_t=(t/I,1): the shear is an exact action-angle family tangent; fixed-charge orbital and shifted-frequency modulated stability pass.

taub_maps.statement: No second-order Taub map is inferred from the homogeneous action-angle normal form.

scope.carrier: global Darboux pair (psi mod 2*pi,Q_rel) imported from the 70-row causal parent

entries.claim_boundary: The exact reduced helical family and the isolated complete coupled stationary locus are distinct carriers. Name matching does not identify them.

dispersion.statement: This row is a stationary-locus separator, not a propagating mode.

lee_wald.statement: The charge direction exists on the unrestricted parent but is transverse to the full coupled stationary locus.

resonance.statement: At fixed geometry all three stationary rows equal -(16*(Q/I)^2-9)/32, with only isolated roots +/-Q0.

bounded_or_finite_quasiperiodic.statement: The separator decides existence of nearby coupled backgrounds, not time stability.

causal_retarded.statement: Causal transport away from the isolated selected background is not certified.

smooth_secular.statement: The stationary separator is -(5*Q_rel^2-162*pi^4)/(576*pi^4): the reduced family tangent does not lift to a nearby complete fixed-action Berger family, and the full linearized constraint requires delta Q_rel=0.

taub_maps.statement: No tangent-cone or Taub identification is made.
